prompt.es: Elige la apertura más eficaz para una reclamación escrita.

choices.text: Hello, I hope you are well. I wanted to tell you a few things about my recent experience with you.
I am extremely angry, and your company is useless.
I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March, which arrived faulty.

feedback.es: La buena apertura dice el motivo y da un dato verificable (producto y fecha); las otras no informan o insultan.

hint.es: Dice el motivo de inmediato, sin insultos.

origin.text: Situation: you bought an oven on 3 March; it arrived two weeks late and does not work. You write to the shop.

prompt.es: Completa: «Este retraso es inaceptable y espero que lo resuelvan esta semana.»

feedback.es: Unacceptable expresa firmeza en un registro formal, sin recurrir a insultos.

hint.es: Adjetivo formal que significa «que no se puede aceptar».

origin.text: The oven has been broken for two weeks, and nobody has called me back. This delay is ___, and I expect you to resolve it this week.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Espero que usted resuelva el problema esta semana.»

answer.text: I expect you to resolve the problem this week

feedback.es: Expect + objeto + to + verbo expresa una expectativa firme y formal.

prompt.es: Escucha la respuesta de la empresa y elige qué ofrece.

choices.text: The full price back today.
A new product on Friday.
A discount on the next order.

feedback.es: Refund the full price significa devolver todo el dinero, y el plazo es hoy; la llamada del lunes es solo para quien siga descontento.

origin.audio: Thank you for contacting us. We are sorry about the delay, which fell short of our usual standard, and we will refund the full price today. If you are still dissatisfied, please call our team on Monday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase mantiene un tono firme pero controlado?

choices.text: This is the worst service ever, and you are useless.
I am disappointed, and I would be grateful if you could resolve this.
Whenever you have time, maybe you could possibly think about it.

feedback.es: Expresar la reacción y pedir una solución mantiene la firmeza; insultar o rogar con rodeos la pierde.

origin.text: Your third call about the faulty oven has again gone unanswered, and you are writing to the manager.

prompt.es: Escribe la reclamación formal: hechos, reacción, petición concreta y plazo.

answer.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the oven I bought from your online shop on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and the oven is faulty: it does not heat above 150 degrees. I was disappointed, because we needed it for a family dinner on Saturday, and I am dissatisfied with how my two phone calls were handled. This delay is unacceptable, and it does not live up to the promises on your website. I would therefore be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund by Friday, and I expect you to resolve the matter this week. Otherwise, I will have to take the matter further. I have kept the original receipt, and I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding the oven I bought on 3 March from your website. It arrived two weeks late, and it is broken: it never gets properly hot. I am disappointed, because we wanted to use it for a family dinner on Saturday, and I am dissatisfied with the way my calls were handled. Such a delay is unacceptable, and it does not live up to what your website promises. I would be grateful if you could send a replacement or refund the full price by Friday, and I expect you to resolve this week. If not, I will take the matter further. I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about a faulty oven that I bought on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and the oven does not work properly. I was disappointed, because it was for a family dinner, and I am dissatisfied with the service on the phone. This delay is unacceptable, so I would like you to arrange a replacement or a full refund before Friday. I expect you to resolve the problem this week; otherwise, I will take the matter further. Thank you for your attention, and I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

feedback.es: La reclamación ordena motivo, hechos, reacción, petición, plazo y advertencia, en un registro formal sostenido.

origin.text: Compraste un horno en la tienda en línea el 3 de marzo. Llegó con dos semanas de retraso y está defectuoso (no calienta bien). Tenías una cena familiar el sábado y te sentiste decepcionado; además, estás insatisfecho con cómo trataron tus dos llamadas. El retraso es inaceptable. Pide un horno nuevo o el reembolso completo antes del viernes y advierte de que llevarás el asunto más allá. Tono formal y firme, con saludo y despedida.

prompt.es: ¿Qué rasgo rompe el registro formal de esta reclamación?

choices.text: The formal greeting.
The deadline for a reply.
The informal closing: Cheers!

feedback.es: Cheers! es un cierre informal que no encaja con Dear Sir or Madam ni con I would be grateful.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about a faulty oven that I bought on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and I am dissatisfied with the service. I would be grateful for a reply by Friday. Cheers!

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender la empresa sobre su responsabilidad?

choices.text: That it offers compensation without formally accepting blame.
That it admits the fault was entirely its own.
That it blames the delivery company for the delay.

feedback.es: Ofrece un descuento «as a goodwill gesture» y aclara que eso no significa que nadie fuera culpable: compensa sin admitir culpa formal.

origin.text: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message. We are sorry that your oven arrived late and faulty; this falls short of the standard we set ourselves. We will send a replacement by Friday, free of charge, and we will add a discount on your next purchase as a goodwill gesture, which does not mean that anyone at our store was at fault. Please note that the replacement can only be delivered if somebody is at home, so let us know a convenient time. Kind regards, Customer Care

prompt.es: Escucha esta reclamación y elige el diagnóstico de su tono.

choices.text: Stiff: too official for the situation.
Blunt and angry: orders without any polite marker.
Warm and polite, despite the problem.

feedback.es: Dos órdenes secas y un reproche sin marcadores de cortesía forman un mensaje brusco; habría que suavizarlo con could y una petición concreta.

origin.audio: Right, listen. Your oven arrived two weeks late, and now it doesn't work. I've called three times and nobody has answered. Give me my money back now. I will not wait any longer, and I will not repeat myself.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta de la empresa incluye disculpa, solución y plazo?

choices.text: Thank you for writing. We will think about it and let you know later.
We are sorry you feel that way. Please wait for our next message.
We apologise for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement by Friday.

feedback.es: La buena respuesta pide disculpas, ofrece una solución concreta y fija una fecha; las otras dos no se comprometen a nada.

origin.text: Customer message: «My replacement oven has not arrived, and I expect you to resolve this.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Le ofreceremos una compensación por el retraso.»

feedback.es: Compensation es lo que la empresa ofrece para reparar el daño causado.

origin.text: We know the delivery fell short of what you expected, so we will offer you ___ for the delay.

prompt.es: Escribe la respuesta breve de la empresa a la reclamación de Carlos.

answer.text: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement oven by Friday, and we will offer you compensation for the delay, which fell short of the standard we aim for. Please contact us if you need any further assistance. Kind regards, Customer Service
accepted: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement oven by Friday, and we will offer you compensation for the delay, which fell short of the standard we aim for. Please contact us if you need any further assistance. Kind regards, Customer Service

Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for contacting us. We apologise for the delay and for the faulty oven, which fell short of our usual standard. A replacement will be sent before Friday, and we will also offer you compensation. Kind regards, Customer Service

feedback.es: La respuesta agradece, se disculpa, da una solución con plazo y cierra con cortesía en el mismo registro formal.

origin.text: Responde como la empresa: agradece el mensaje, pide disculpas, ofrece un horno nuevo antes del viernes y una compensación, y cierra con un saludo formal.
